about: InDesign 2025 (20.5.5), real mouse drawing with the shape and frame tools on a 300 x 400 point page of a spread turned by View > Rotate Spread (cw = 90 CW, ccw = 90 CCW, 180), liveinput-c2. Points are page-as-shown points from its top-left corner; Shift/Alt are held while dragging and released after the button (realinput mod_release_delay). `idml` is what the exported IDML stores for the new item.
